# owner: platform
"""Contact sheet for substitute teachers."""

from typing import Iterable, List

from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.models import Student

# ---
def format_contact_row(student: Student) -> str:
    """One row: name, section and email in columns."""
    if not student.email:
        raise ProjectError(
            f"no email for {student.display_name}"
        )
    name = student.display_name
    section = student.section
    email = student.email
    return f"{name:<20} {section:<8} {email}"

# ---
def contact_sheet(students: Iterable[Student]) -> List[str]:
    """Rows sorted by name, one per student."""
    roster = list(students)
    if not roster:
        raise ProjectError("no students given")
    ordered = sorted(
        roster, key=lambda item: item.display_name
    )
    return [format_contact_row(item) for item in ordered]
